query:
SELECT
            channel_id AS "channel_id!",
            id
        FROM comms_messages
        WHERE
            -- channel search backfill: entity-parented thread messages have
            -- no channel and are not indexed here
            channel_id IS NOT NULL
            AND (
                $3::bool IS NULL
                OR ($3 AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL)
                OR (NOT $3 AND deleted_at IS NULL)
            )
        ORDER BY created_at ASC
        LIMIT $1
        OFFSET $2
